THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare, under Sub - section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. Boundaries to the below land lots with 0.4821 Hectare in extent, depicted in detail in Advanced Tracing No. KU/GNW/2021/549 dated 31.05.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, lacated in the Village of Uyangalla (F.T.P 5), in Grama Niladhari Division of No. 455- Uyangalla, in Minor Division of Mahagalboda Egoda Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ganewatte in, Kurunegala District, North western Province:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Uyangalla Mukalana - Extent: 0.4821 Hectare North: Kimbulwana Oya; East: Uyangalla Mukalana claimed by R.D.B.Senadheera; South: Road and Canal; West: Canal and Kimbulwana Oya.
K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/2/2019/IR/390.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.24th January, 2025.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described, here in below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. Boundaries to the land lots with below names and extents as depicted in detail in Advanced Tracing No. KU/GNW/2021/551 dated 31.05.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, located in the Village of Seerangoda, in Grama Niladhari Division of No. 448 - Seerangoda, in Mahagalboda Egoda Korale, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ganewatte in, the District of Kurunegala, in North Western Province:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Seerangodamukalana Moragodayaya - Extent: 0.0976 Hectare North: Road and Seerangodamukalana alias Moragodayaya claimed by G.A. Sumathipala; East: Deduru Oya Reservoir; South: Lot B and Road; West: Seerangodamukalana alias Moragodayaya claimed by T.G.G. Ajith Premalal and Road.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Seerangodamukalana Moragodayaya - Extent: 0.0825 Hectare North: Lot A; East: Deduru Oya Reservoir; South: Seerangodamukalana alias Moragodayaya claimed by M.M. Keerthirathna; West: Road.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Seerangodamukalana Moragodayaya - Extent: 0.1029 Hectare North: Seerangodamukalana alias Moragodayaya claimed by M.M. Keerthirathna, Road and Seerangodamukalana alias Moragodayaya claimed by M.M. Keerthirathna; East: Seerangodamukalana alias Moragodayaya claimed by M.M. Keerthirathna and Deduru Oya Reservoir; South: Deduru Oya Reservoir and Road; West: Road and Seerangodamukala alias Moragodayaya claimed by H.A. Karunarathna.
04. Lot ‘D’ – Seerangodamukalana Moragodayaya - Extent: 0.1590 Hectare North: Road; East: Road and Deduru Oya Reservoir; South: Deduru Oya Reservoir; West: Deduru Oya Reservoir.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2019/IR/391.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Avenue, Battaramulla.04th December, 2024.
